title: Line of Intersection of Two Planes
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the direction vector v for the line of intersection of the two planes x + y + z = 1 and x - 2y + 3z = 2.

steps.title: Identify Normal Vectors of Both Planes
steps.explanation: Read coefficients of x, y, and z for each plane equation.

steps.title: Cross Product of Normal Vectors
steps.explanation: The line of intersection lies in both planes, so its direction is orthogonal to both normal vectors.
steps.why: Determining line direction via cross product.
